title: AusKidTalk: developing an orthographic annotation workflow for a speech corpus of Australian English-speaking children
why_promising: Primary child speech corpus; workflow presents automatically proposed target-word intervals to annotators for manual correction and records noisy targets/mispronunciations. This creates an isolatable human-corrected target-word layer potentially useful for production timing, lexical context, errors and child-speech metadata.
open_question: Locate authoritative public release; enumerate audio/TextGrid/metadata files; establish exactly which intervals were manually corrected versus skipped; admit only explicitly corrected intervals and preserve automatic tiers separately/out of core.

title: A multimodal speech-production dataset with time-aligned articulography, EEG, audio, and vocal-tract anatomy
why_promising: Primary German speech production from 29 adults with synchronized EMA+EEG+audio; tasks include DDK at habitual/maximal rate, passage reading, sustained vowels and palate tracing; 18-speaker anatomical subset adds pharyngometry, rhinometry and 3D head meshes. Very broad articulatory/anatomical coverage.
open_question: Inspect public deposit and methods for human-created/corrected interval, event, landmark or quality-control labels. Raw synchronized trajectories alone do not satisfy manual-annotation inclusion; isolate any qualifying human-verified layer before core admission.

title: Prosodic modulations in child-directed language and their impact on word learning
why_promising: Primary caregiver production: 6,658 target referents initially obtained; 6,529 retained after overlap/noise exclusions. Speech was manually transcribed; MAUS word alignment was manually corrected by an expert; every target-word boundary was checked/corrected in Praat, with 10.5% independently checked by a second coder. Rich predictors include IDS context, word position, mention status, utterance type, repetition and session order.
open_question: Locate public OSF/data deposit and determine whether token-level acoustic/prosodic measurements, corrected boundary timestamps/TextGrids and speaker/session metadata are downloadable. Ingest only primary production data and keep child word-learning outcomes separate from production tables.
